name: core-runtime-proof
truth_boundary: This contract proves only behavior observed in the GitHub-hosted Docker Compose environment. It is not production readiness, external adoption, target-PC validation, or proof that optional Syntra/Aetheris browser and workstation integrations run on the owner's future hardware.

checks.claim: PostgreSQL accepts connections inside the Compose stack.
Redis responds to PING inside the Compose stack.
RabbitMQ diagnostics report the broker is responsive.
Registration through the gateway returns access and refresh tokens.
Protected user routes reject missing bearer tokens.
A valid access token with users:read can read the user route through the gateway.
An API_CONSUMER token is denied users:write access through the gateway.
The previous refresh token is rejected after rotation.
Logout revokes the active refresh token.
Reading a user materializes a Redis userById cache entry.
Reading the user list materializes a Redis usersList cache entry.
A user.created event published through RabbitMQ is observed by the audit service.
When user-service is stopped, the gateway returns the configured user-service fallback response.
After user-service restarts, the protected gateway route becomes healthy again.
